content.text: {"jurisdiction":"european_union","issuing_body":"European Commission / AI Office","document_type":"regulatory_guidance","binding_strength":"binding_law","publication_date":null,"effective_date":"2025-08-02","covered_application_domains":["general_purpose_models"],"safety_requirements":[{"label":"transparency_disclosure","confidence":0.98,"evidence":[{"quote":"All providers of general-purpose AI models are required to publish a summary of the content used to train their models, based on a template provided by the Commission.","source_section":"Introduction"},{"quote":"The Summary must be made publicly available no later than when a model is placed on the Union market.","source_section":"Publication requirements"}]},{"label":"model_documentation","confidence":0.9,"evidence":[{"quote":"The Template provides a uniform baseline for information to be publicly disclosed in the Summary, consisting of three main sections: General information, List of data sources, Relevant data processing aspects.","source_section":"Template structure"}]}],"enforcement_mechanisms":[{"label":"civil_penalty","confidence":0.97,"evidence":[{"quote":"Non-compliance may result in fines of up to 3% of the provider's annual total worldwide turnover in the preceding financial year, or 15 000 000 Euros, whichever is higher.","source_section":"Enforcement"}]},{"label":"regulatory_supervision","confidence":0.9,"evidence":[{"quote":"Failure to provide this summary can lead to enforcement actions by the AI Office as of 2 August 2026.","source_section":"Enforcement"}]}],"implementation_notes":"Template use is mandatory under Article 53(1)(d) of the AI Act. Obligation applies from 2 August 2025 for new models; existing models have until 2 August 2027. Enforcement actions possible from 2 August 2026. Applies to open-source model providers as well. Code of Practice adherence remains voluntary and addresses separate obligations.","confidence":0.95}
